models.name: Game Boy
models.accuracy_notes: invented rear warning removed, original DMG tooling and gamebit screw added; Curved logo pocket with raised lettering and baked short-range contact shading; recess depth is photo-estimated.; Original Nintendo and GAME BOY vector shapes projected into baked shallow relief on the actual shell surface, replacing separate overlapping glyph meshes. 2048 normal texture; authored relief depth 0.10mm (Kirby 0.16mm), not measured tooling.
